user.title: Set up Haiku Notify
user.description: Create a notify.* service that rephrases messages through your Anthropic AI integration before forwarding them to an existing notify service.

data.name: Service name (will be registered as notify.<name>)
data.wrapped_service: Notify service to forward to (e.g. notify.discord_automations)
data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity to use for rephrasing
data.history_size: Recent messages to include as context
data.instructions: Rephrasing instructions sent to the AI (leave default for general use)

error.invalid_wrapped_service: Must look like notify.something (no extra dots)

abort.already_configured: This service name is already set up.
